name: nemlig-shopping
description: Find Nemlig groceries, edit an automatically saved shopping list, and add its reviewed products to the Nemlig basket only when asked.

interface.defaultPrompt: Help me shop on Nemlig. Offer to find products, create a shopping list, or open an existing one. Once I choose products for a shopping list, save it to Nemlig and save my edits automatically. Do not open an unrelated list or add anything to my Nemlig basket unless I ask.
interface.longDescription: Find current Nemlig products and compare sizes and prices. Create a shopping list from your chosen products and edit it interactively, with changes saved directly to Nemlig. Add its reviewed products to your real basket only after authorization. No checkout or payment.
